I'm going to share my entire flow this week, but this:

 - Wrote a script for the entire video
 - Found the relevant footage from Youtube and archives, under creative commons license
 - Trimmed and cropped those videos
 - Upscaled and colorized those videos
 - Put it together with voiceover and labels
 - Scored the soundtrack 
 - Critiqued the final edit to improve iteratively

And came up with this! It's not perfect (tell me what it gets wrong) but I've always liked making moving stories and there was just no way I could've done this before.

tweets.text:
SPACE's gateway learned which IPs belonged to allowed domains like pypi(dot)org from DNS traffic, and enforced by IP.

The models beat it two ways. Some forged a DNS reply mapping pypi(dot)org to the callback's IP. Others used services sharing PyPI's Fastly address to fetch the callback.

Each model ran both tasks with and without SPACE's source code, 216 runs in all.

No escape run succeeded in 108 tries, and no bypass run did with traffic blocked.

Under partial-network conditions, four models (Claude Opus 5.0, GPT-5.6 Cyber, GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3) identified vulnerabilities in network confinement and used permitted network access to retrieve the secret flag
